content: Word Vectors as Input: The input of the paragraph-level discourse relation prediction model is a sequence of word vectors, one vector per word in the paragraph. In this work, we used the pre-trained 300-dimension Google English word2vec embeddings. For each word that is not in the vocabulary of Google word2vec, we will randomly initialize a vector with each dimension sampled from the range $[-0.25, 0.25]$ . In addition, recognizing key entities and discourse connective phrases is important for discourse relation recognition, therefore, we concatenate the raw word embeddings with extra linguistic features, specifically one-hot Part-Of-Speech tag embeddings and one-hot named entity tag embeddings.
